purpose: test whether any currently holding-reward-eligible BTC ETH or SOL binary market publicly values an equal mergeable YES plus NO complete set far enough above one pUSD to improve the accepted direction-neutral holding-yield economics

market_requirements: exactly two outcomes and two CLOB token ids

requests: one GET Gamma event by slug for each frozen event slug
one POST CLOB /midpoints containing every admitted token id
request_contract.raw_persistence: persist each successful response before decoding or evaluating it
request_contract.failure_action: write a terminal failure result and do not substitute markets endpoints or rerun

economic_identity.threshold_identity: (comparison annual rate + external friction sensitivity * 365 / maximum horizon days) / official annual rate

public_uplift_candidate_requires: complete-set midpoint sum at least the frozen escalation threshold
both token midpoint responses present and numeric
market passes every frozen eligibility flag
accepted_edge_requires_additionally: prospective persistence across randomized hourly reward sampling
owned account eligibility and full split hold merge lineage
exact alternative yield and every external cost
no reliance on stale crossed or unavailable books
acceptance_boundary.failed_public_gate_action: record the current-state uplift screen as negative and do not collect history or books

prohibited_shortcuts: treating a sub-threshold midpoint sum as economically meaningful
using last trade prices instead of the documented midpoint valuation
including noneligible inactive closed or nonbinary markets
assuming one current snapshot proves persistence
altering the friction horizon rate or threshold after midpoint access
